task.description:
Implement PD-03 (Version management) in `src/definition/store.zig`.

PD-03 requires that:
- Only one version per definition name may have status = ACTIVE at any time.
- Activating a DRAFT version atomically sets the prior ACTIVE version of the same name to DEPRECATED in the same transaction.
- Activating a DEPRECATED or ARCHIVED definition is rejected with HTTP 409 (error: `not_draft`).
- Activating the already-ACTIVE version of the same name is a no-op returning success (idempotent).
- Listing definitions filtered by `status=ACTIVE` returns at most one version per name.

Implementation steps:
1. Add a public `activate` function to the `Store` struct in `src/definition/store.zig`. The function accepts a definition UUID and a db allocator, runs a transaction that:
   a. SELECTs the target definition row FOR UPDATE and verifies it is in DRAFT status.
   b. If it is already ACTIVE, returns success immediately (idempotent no-op).
   c. If it is DEPRECATED or ARCHIVED, returns error.not_draft.
   d. UPDATEs any existing ACTIVE row for the same name to DEPRECATED.
   e. UPDATEs the target row from DRAFT to ACTIVE.
   All in a single atomic transaction.
2. Add the `already_active`, `not_draft`, `definition_not_found` entries to the module error set if not already present.
3. Do NOT add a new migration — the `process_definitions` table already has the required `status` column with the correct CHECK constraint from migration 004.
4. Add a `GET /definitions?status=ACTIVE` filter path to the existing `listDefinitions` query (if not already filtering by status).

Security rules:
- Use $1/$2 placeholders for all SQL. No string interpolation of user data.
- No I/O in src/engine/transition.zig.

Validate:
```
zig build
zig build test
```
Both must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: Atomic DEPRECATED swap runs in a single SQL transaction
Error set includes not_draft, already_active, definition_not_found

result.summary: Implemented PD-03 (Version management) in src/definition/store.zig. Added Store.activate() function with atomic BEGIN/UPDATE-deprecated/UPDATE-active/COMMIT transaction. Added AlreadyActive and NotDraft to DefinitionError. Added begin/commit/rollback transaction helpers to db.Conn in src/db/pool.zig. No new migration required — status column and uq_active_definition partial unique index already present in migration 004. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
